description: This file defines React functional components serving as skeleton placeholders for loading states in a video streaming front-end, including SkeletonCard, SkeletonGrid, and SkeletonPlayer.

methods.name: SkeletonCard
methods.description: A React component that renders a skeleton placeholder for a video card with thumbnail and title lines.

methods.name: SkeletonGrid
methods.description: A React component that renders a responsive grid of skeleton cards, simulating a list of video thumbnails.

methods.name: SkeletonPlayer
methods.description: A React component that renders a skeleton placeholder for a large video player with metadata lines.
